# Financial Dashboard Automation %

**Category:** Reporting / BI Automation
**Definition:** % of dashboards automatically generated from live system data via BI platform integrations.

**Why It Matters:** Reduces lag, ensures decisions are data-driven, and eliminates manual reporting effort.

**Formula:** Automated Dashboards ÷ Total Dashboards × 100

**Data Sources:** BI platform logs, ERP integrations.

**Example Target / Benchmarks:** 100% for core reports.

**Enables:** Financial Dashboard Automation % (BODM)
